## Live replacement

**Live file swap: none.** No documented session swap or hot reload for this title; builds are new GDI images launched cold.

**Pick whip: partial.** pick projects entities through the RAM camera and extracts the picked enemy model from the disc (Booma -> pso_dc_beast GLB). pick_replace live needs a declared arena (enemy model grows); expected build fallback, not run.

**Live controls:** pso_mods / pso_live ops supported on US DC Ver. 2 per docs/pso-controls.md (item create/equip, equip_any, speed/rapid-fire cave 0x8C02DF90); accuracy not available on DC.
